## Description
Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue (if applicable). Please also include relevant motivation and context.

Fixes #(issue number)

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement / Code refactor

## Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] All image processing strictly remains 100% client-side (no image data sent to any server)
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand binary parsing areas
- [ ] The build passes cleanly with `npm run build`
